common_conditions: TS33.180 V19.4.0 supporting security mechanisms; reference-point-specific scope
condition_rule: Inherit common_conditions and add claim conditions.

conditions: HTTP-1 between MC UE HTTP client and server endpoint
claims.conclusion: TLS support is mandatory. One of the following authentication mechanisms shall be performed: server-certificate one-way authentication, certificate mutual authentication or PSK mutual authentication; certificate and TLS profiles refer to TS33.310. PKI structure is out of scope; no universal client-certificate requirement follows.

conditions: SIP core access and SIP-1 signalling
claims.conclusion: IMS AKA applies regardless of TS23.228-compliant core architecture. Non-3GPP access may consider TS33.203 Annex N/O mechanisms; non-3GPP-only UEs without UICC may consider its clause9 IMC. The former use cases use NDS/IP unless otherwise secured, e.g. physically. SIP-1 confidentiality/integrity follows TS33.203 Gm security.

limitations: TS33.203,33.210,33.310 referenced profiles are not checked here; no deployable cipher/configuration recipe.
This does not verify application user tokens, inter-domain authorization or media key security.
V19.4.0 only; no equivalence to V19.5.0 asserted.
